lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible on the mid-lateral flank. The centroids of these clusters are arranged in a staggered spatial distribution with relatively uniform horizontal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of circular spots, forming an orthogonal grid of high-luminance nodes across the central flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is observed on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the superior side and low-luminance values in the inferior shadow region.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct Echeneidae individuals are visible attached to the ventral region; the larger individual is positioned posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
